entities.summary: Amália Scudeler de Barros Santos was a Brazilian journalist and politician, affiliated with the Liberal Party (PL), which she served as a federal deputy for Mato Grosso from 2023 to 2024. She was also a journalism graduate and had worked as a rodeo show narrator.

entities.summary: Amália Scudeler de Barros Santos was a Brazilian journalist and politician, affiliated with the Liberal Party (PL), which she served as a federal deputy for Mato Grosso from 2023 to 2024. She was also a journalism graduate and had worked as a rodeo show narrator.
